#!/usr/bin/env bash
# 01_PRE_CUTOVER_READONLY_PREFLIGHT.sh
# Read-only enumeration of EVERY root-equivalent / re-grant source for AGENT_USER
# (default k3). Safe to run repeatedly; performs NO mutation. Fixes review
# U24/U15/S01-S13/FR1/AX5 + section 13.
#
# Fail-closed: any OPEN vector OR any INDETERMINATE probe -> exit 3. A non-root
# run cannot read privileged sources, so it reports INDETERMINATE and exits 3
# (never a false PREFLIGHT=CLEAN). --strict additionally escalates advisories.
# shellcheck shell=bash
set -uo pipefail
SCRIPT_DIR=$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)
# shellcheck source=lib/common.sh
. "$SCRIPT_DIR/lib/common.sh" || { echo "FATAL: cannot source lib/common.sh (fail-closed)" >&2; exit 1; }

STRICT=0
for a in "$@"; do [ "$a" = "--strict" ] && STRICT=1; done
IS_ROOT=0; [ "$(id -u)" = "0" ] && IS_ROOT=1
OPEN=0
note_open() { OPEN=$((OPEN+1)); printf '  [OPEN] %s\n' "$*"; }
note_indet(){ OPEN=$((OPEN+1)); printf '  [INDETERMINATE] %s\n' "$*"; }   # fail-closed
note_ok()   { printf '  [OK] %s\n' "$*"; }
note_info() { printf '  [INFO] %s\n' "$*"; }
# advisory: [WARN] normally, but escalates to OPEN (fail-closed) under --strict.
note_warn() { if [ "$STRICT" = 1 ]; then OPEN=$((OPEN+1)); printf '  [OPEN:strict] %s\n' "$*"; else printf '  [WARN] %s\n' "$*"; fi; }
REBOOT_REQUIRED=NO
set_reboot() { REBOOT_REQUIRED=YES; }

log "=== P5 PRE-CUTOVER READ-ONLY PREFLIGHT (AGENT_USER=$AGENT_USER, root=$IS_ROOT, strict=$STRICT) ==="
assert_agent_user_resolves
[ "$IS_ROOT" = 1 ] || note_indet "preflight NOT run as root: sudoers, root/admin authorized_keys, and some sources are unreadable; a CLEAN verdict requires root"

echo "== identity & groups =="
id "$AGENT_USER" 2>&1 | sed 's/^/  /'
# F7-16(a): a failing `id -nG` must NOT silently yield an empty set (false-CLEAN);
# capture explicitly and mark INDETERMINATE (blocks CLEAN) on failure.
if ! AGENT_GROUPS="$(id -nG "$AGENT_USER" 2>/dev/null)"; then
  note_indet "id -nG $AGENT_USER failed тА?cannot enumerate agent groups (fail-closed; blocks CLEAN)"
  AGENT_GROUPS=""
fi
for g in "${ROOT_EQUIVALENT_GROUPS[@]}"; do
  printf '%s\n' $AGENT_GROUPS | grep -qx "$g" && note_open "AGENT_USER is in root-equivalent group: $g (remove at cutover)"
done

echo "== sudo (all sources) =="
if have sudo; then
  if [ "$IS_ROOT" = 1 ]; then
    if sudo -n -l -U "$AGENT_USER" >/tmp/.p5_sudo_l.$$ 2>/dev/null; then
      # F10-13: ANY grant is a vector тА?incl. password-required SINGLE-COMMAND (GTFOBins) grants,
      # not only NOPASSWD/ALL. "may run the following" appears for every grant.
      grep -qiE 'may run the following|NOPASSWD|\(ALL|ALL[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*ALL|ALL\)' /tmp/.p5_sudo_l.$$ \
        && note_open "AGENT_USER has usable sudo grants (sudo -l; incl. password-required single-command grants)"
      rm -f /tmp/.p5_sudo_l.$$
    fi
    for f in /etc/sudoers /etc/sudoers.d/*; do
      [ -f "$f" ] || continue
      # (a) ANY DIRECT grant to the agent user is an OPEN vector.
      if grep -REqs "(^|[[:space:]]|,|=|\(|:)${AGENT_USER}([[:space:]]|,|=|\)|:|$)" "$f" 2>/dev/null; then
        note_open "sudoers source grants agent DIRECTLY (remove/neutralize): $f"
        grep -nE "${AGENT_USER}|NOPASSWD" "$f" 2>/dev/null | sed 's/^/    /'
      fi
      # (b) F10-8: a %group sudo grant is OPEN only if the agent is a MEMBER of that group. The distro-default
      #     %sudo/%wheel/%admin line ships on every host; flagging it unconditionally made CLEAN unreachable.
      for grp in $(grep -oE '(^|[[:space:]])%[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+' "$f" 2>/dev/null | tr -d ' %' | sort -u); do
        if printf '%s\n' $AGENT_GROUPS | grep -qx "$grp"; then
          note_open "sudoers grants group %$grp AND agent is a member: $f (remove agent from $grp)"
        else
          note_info "sudoers grants group %$grp (agent NOT a member): $f"
        fi
      done
    done
  else
    note_indet "cannot read /etc/sudoers* as non-root"
  fi
else
  note_info "sudo not installed"
fi

echo "== sudo credential timestamps =="
if [ "$IS_ROOT" = 1 ]; then
  for ts in /run/sudo/ts/"$AGENT_USER" /var/lib/sudo/ts/"$AGENT_USER" /var/db/sudo/"$AGENT_USER"; do
    [ -e "$ts" ] && note_open "cached sudo timestamp present for agent: $ts (invalidate at cutover)"
  done
else
  note_indet "cannot inspect sudo timestamp dir as non-root"
fi

echo "== cloud re-grant: google-sudoers / guest-agent / OS Login / metadata =="
GUEST_PRESENT=no
for svc in google-guest-agent google-osconfig-agent google-guest-agent-manager google-accounts-daemon; do
  if have systemctl && { systemctl is-active "$svc" >/dev/null 2>&1 || systemctl is-enabled "$svc" >/dev/null 2>&1; }; then
    GUEST_PRESENT=yes; note_open "cloud guest agent present (active OR enabled): $svc (can re-provision sudo/keys -> D1/D2)"
  fi
done
for f in /etc/sudoers.d/google_sudoers /etc/sudoers.d/google-sudoers /etc/sudoers.d/90-cloud-init-users /etc/sudoers.d/google-oslogin; do
  [ -e "$f" ] && note_open "cloud-managed sudoers file present: $f"
done
if grep -RqsE 'AuthorizedKeysCommand|google_authorized_keys|oslogin' /etc/ssh/sshd_config /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/ 2>/dev/null; then
  note_open "sshd uses OS Login / AuthorizedKeysCommand (provider can inject keys -> D2)"
fi
if [ "$GUEST_PRESENT" = yes ]; then set_reboot; note_info "cutover must remove k3 cloud IAM login/sudo role + instance SSH-key metadata, then reboot + re-run this preflight"; fi

echo "== docker =="
getent group docker 2>/dev/null | grep -qE "(:|,)${AGENT_USER}(,|$)" && note_open "docker group lists AGENT_USER"
if [ -S /var/run/docker.sock ]; then
  note_info "docker.sock: $(stat -c '%a %U:%G' /var/run/docker.sock 2>/dev/null)"
  if find /var/run/docker.sock -perm -002 2>/dev/null | grep -q .; then note_open "docker.sock is WORLD-writable тА?critical root-equivalent"
  elif find /var/run/docker.sock -perm -020 2>/dev/null | grep -q .; then
    dsock_grp="$(stat -c '%G' /var/run/docker.sock 2>/dev/null || true)"
    if [ -n "$dsock_grp" ] && printf '%s' " $AGENT_GROUPS " | grep -q " $dsock_grp "; then
      note_open "docker.sock group-writable and agent is in owning group '$dsock_grp' тА?root-equivalent (F7-12 D3)"
    else
      note_warn "docker.sock is group-writable (owning group '$dsock_grp'; escalated under --strict)"
    fi
  fi
fi
if grep -RqsE 'tcp://|"hosts"' /etc/docker/daemon.json 2>/dev/null; then note_open "dockerd exposes a TCP endpoint (daemon.json hosts) тА?root-equivalent over network"; fi
if have systemctl; then
  # F10-14: check each unit separately тА?a combined `systemctl cat a b` exits nonzero if one is absent,
  # which under pipefail could drop a real `-H tcp://` in the other unit (false-negative).
  for u in docker.service docker.socket; do
    systemctl cat "$u" 2>/dev/null | grep -qE 'tcp://' && note_open "dockerd $u configures a TCP endpoint (-H tcp://) тА?root-equivalent over network (D3/R-2)"
  done
fi
# F7-3: docker.socket ListenStream exposing a TCP port (incl. bare-port ListenStream=2375) is root-equivalent over the network.
if have systemctl && systemctl cat docker.socket 2>/dev/null | grep -Eq '^[[:space:]]*ListenStream[[:space:]]*=[[:space:]]*([^[:space:]]*:)?[0-9]+[[:space:]]*$'; then
  note_open "docker.socket ListenStream exposes a TCP port тА?root-equivalent over network (D3/R-2)"
fi
if have docker && timeout 8 docker ps >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  note_info "docker daemon reachable now (expected pre-cutover)"
  while IFS= read -r c; do
    [ -n "$c" ] || continue
    if timeout 8 docker inspect "$c" --format 'P={{.HostConfig.Privileged}} PID={{.HostConfig.PidMode}} IPC={{.HostConfig.IpcMode}} USERNS={{.HostConfig.UsernsMode}} CAP={{.HostConfig.CapAdd}} SEC={{.HostConfig.SecurityOpt}} M={{range .Mounts}}{{.Source}}->{{.Destination}};{{end}}' 2>/dev/null \
        | grep -qEi 'P=true|(^|[|;])true[|]|PID=host|IPC=host|USERNS=host|SYS_ADMIN|SYS_PTRACE|SYS_MODULE|SYS_BOOT|DAC_READ_SEARCH|DAC_OVERRIDE|\[ALL\]|unconfined|/run/docker\.sock|containerd\.sock|crio\.sock|(M=|^|[|;])/->|(M=|^|[|;])/(etc|root|proc|sys|boot|var/lib/docker)->|(M=|^|[|;])/etc/(shadow|gshadow|sudoers)'; then
      note_open "privileged/host-namespace/host-mount/escape-capable container reachable: $c (D7/CX-container)"
    fi
  done < <(timeout 8 docker ps -q 2>/dev/null)
fi

echo "== lxd =="
getent group lxd 2>/dev/null | grep -qE "(:|,)${AGENT_USER}(,|$)" && note_open "lxd group lists AGENT_USER"
for s in /var/snap/lxd/common/lxd/unix.socket /run/lxd/unix.socket /var/lib/lxd/unix.socket; do
  [ -S "$s" ] || continue
  note_info "lxd socket: $s ($(stat -c '%a %U:%G' "$s" 2>/dev/null))"
  lxd_grp="$(stat -c '%G' "$s" 2>/dev/null || true)"
  if [ -n "$lxd_grp" ] && find "$s" -perm -020 2>/dev/null | grep -q . && printf '%s' " $AGENT_GROUPS " | grep -q " $lxd_grp "; then
    note_open "lxd socket group-writable and agent in owning group '$lxd_grp' тА?root-equivalent (F7-12 D3)"
  fi
done
if have lxc && timeout 10 lxc list >/dev/null 2>&1; then note_info "lxc reachable now (expected pre-cutover; must be denied post-cutover via lxd group removal + socket)"; fi

echo "== cron / systemd timers (re-grant scan, D3) =="
REGRANT_RE="gpasswd|usermod|adduser|deluser|/etc/sudoers|sudoers.d|visudo|usermod -aG|chmod .*docker.sock|tcp://"
for f in /etc/crontab /etc/cron.d/* /etc/cron.hourly/* /etc/cron.daily/* /etc/cron.weekly/* /etc/cron.monthly/* /var/spool/cron/crontabs/*; do
  [ -f "$f" ] || continue
  grep -Eqsi "$REGRANT_RE" "$f" 2>/dev/null && { note_open "cron entry mutates group/sudoers (possible re-grant): $f"; grep -nEi "$REGRANT_RE" "$f" | sed 's/^/    /'; }
done
if have systemctl; then
  while IFS= read -r unit; do
    [ -n "$unit" ] || continue
    ex="$(systemctl cat "$unit" 2>/dev/null | grep -E '^[[:space:]]*Exec[A-Za-z]+=' || true)"
    # F10-10: match a re-grant COMMAND, or the agent as a bounded PRINCIPAL (User=k3, -u k3, ' k3 '),
    # not the bare substring 'k3' that trips on /data/k3 runtime paths (esp. this deployment's own unit).
    if printf '%s' "$ex" | grep -Eqis "$REGRANT_RE"; then
      note_open "unit $unit Exec* may re-grant (mutation cmd): $ex"
    elif printf '%s' "$ex" | grep -Eqs "(^|[^/[:alnum:]_.-])${AGENT_USER}([^[:alnum:]_.-]|$)"; then
      note_open "unit $unit Exec* references agent principal $AGENT_USER: $ex"
    fi
  done < <(systemctl list-units --type=service,timer --all --plain --no-legend 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1}')
fi

echo "== setuid/setgid (allowlist, D4) =="
ALLOW='/usr/bin/sudo /usr/bin/su /usr/bin/passwd /usr/bin/chsh /usr/bin/chfn /usr/bin/newgrp /usr/bin/gpasswd /usr/bin/mount /usr/bin/umount /usr/bin/fusermount /usr/bin/fusermount3 /usr/bin/pkexec /usr/bin/crontab /usr/bin/at /usr/bin/wall /usr/bin/write /usr/bin/expiry /usr/bin/chage /usr/bin/ssh-agent /usr/bin/dotlockfile /usr/bin/mlocate /usr/lib/dbus-1.0/dbus-daemon-launch-helper /usr/lib/openssh/ssh-keysign /usr/lib/policykit-1/polkit-agent-helper-1 /usr/libexec/polkit-agent-helper-1 /usr/lib/polkit-1/polkit-agent-helper-1 /usr/lib/eject/dmcrypt-get-device /usr/sbin/pppd /usr/sbin/unix_chkpwd /sbin/unix_chkpwd /bin/mount /bin/su /bin/umount /bin/fusermount /usr/lib/snapd/snap-confine /usr/sbin/pam_extrausers_chkpwd /usr/bin/pam_extrausers_chkpwd /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/utempter/utempter /usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu/utempter/utempter /usr/lib/utempter/utempter'
# F13: stock setuid/setgid binaries vary per distro/arch; operator may extend the allowlist per-host
# (after verifying each is a legitimate root-owned stock binary) so the post-cutover CLEAN gate is reachable.
ALLOW="$ALLOW ${P5_EXTRA_SETUID_ALLOW:-}"
AGENT_GID="$(id -gn "$AGENT_USER" 2>/dev/null || echo nogroup)"
while IFS= read -r bin; do
  [ -n "$bin" ] || continue
  case " $ALLOW " in *" $bin "*) : ;; *) note_open "unexpected setuid/setgid binary (not allowlisted): $bin ($(stat -c '%a %U:%G' "$bin" 2>/dev/null))" ;; esac
  # group-writable-by-agent (ANY agent group, not just primary), or world-writable, is escalation (F7-12 D2)
  find "$bin" -perm -002 2>/dev/null | grep -q . && note_open "world-writable setuid binary: $bin"
  bin_grp="$(stat -c '%G' "$bin" 2>/dev/null || true)"
  if [ -n "$bin_grp" ] && find "$bin" -perm -020 2>/dev/null | grep -q . && printf '%s' " $AGENT_GROUPS " | grep -q " $bin_grp "; then
    note_open "setuid binary group-writable by an agent group ($bin_grp): $bin"
  fi
done < <(find /bin /sbin /usr/bin /usr/sbin /usr/local/bin /usr/local/sbin /usr/lib /usr/libexec /opt /home /data /tmp /var/tmp /srv /mnt /media /var/lib /var/local -xdev \( -path '*/docker/*' -o -path '*/containerd/*' -o -path '*/containers/*' -o -path '*/lxd/*' -o -path '/var/snap/*' -o -path '*/kubelet/*' \) -prune -o \( -type f \( -perm -4000 -o -perm -2000 \) -print \) 2>/dev/null | sort)

echo "== file capabilities CAP_* (D-cap, section 13) =="
if have getcap; then
  # F7-11: flag OPEN only for a DANGEROUS cap OR a capability-bearing file that is
  # agent-writable/owned. Baseline caps (cap_net_raw on ping, cap_net_bind_service)
  # on root-owned files are note_info so PREFLIGHT=CLEAN stays reachable on a stock host.
  DANGEROUS_CAPS='cap_setuid|cap_setgid|cap_setpcap|cap_setfcap|cap_dac_override|cap_dac_read_search|cap_sys_admin|cap_sys_ptrace|cap_sys_module|cap_sys_boot|cap_sys_rawio|cap_net_admin|cap_chown|cap_fowner|cap_mknod|cap_mac_admin|cap_mac_override|cap_bpf|cap_perfmon'
  # F13: known stock cap-bearing binaries are root-owned and the agent cannot inject code into them,
  # so their (legitimately broad) caps are NOT an agent privesc vector and must not block the
  # post-cutover CLEAN gate. Non-allowlisted dangerous-cap files, and ANY agent-writable cap file,
  # still escalate to OPEN (planted-backdoor / writable-privesc detection preserved). Operator-extensible.
  CAP_ALLOW='/usr/lib/snapd/snap-confine /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/gstreamer1.0/gstreamer-1.0/gst-ptp-helper /usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu/gstreamer1.0/gstreamer-1.0/gst-ptp-helper /usr/bin/ping /bin/ping /usr/bin/mtr-packet /usr/sbin/mtr-packet'
  CAP_ALLOW="$CAP_ALLOW ${P5_EXTRA_CAP_ALLOW:-}"
  while IFS= read -r line; do
    [ -n "$line" ] || continue
    capfile="${line%% *}"; capspec="${line#* }"   # match the caps FIELD only (not the path) to avoid a path-substring re-break of CLEAN
    case "$capfile" in */docker/*|*/containerd/*|*/containers/*|*/lxd/*|/var/snap/*|*/kubelet/*) continue ;; esac  # V10-A: skip container-image layer contents (not host-exec path)
    capgrp="$(stat -c '%G' "$capfile" 2>/dev/null || true)"
    cap_agentwritable=no
    if find "$capfile" -perm -0002 2>/dev/null | grep -q . \
         || [ "$(stat -c '%U' "$capfile" 2>/dev/null)" = "$AGENT_USER" ] \
         || { [ -n "$capgrp" ] && find "$capfile" -perm -0020 2>/dev/null | grep -q . && printf '%s' " $AGENT_GROUPS " | grep -q " $capgrp "; }; then
      cap_agentwritable=yes
    fi
    if printf '%s' "$capspec" | grep -qiE "$DANGEROUS_CAPS"; then
      if [ "$cap_agentwritable" = no ] && [ "$(stat -c '%U' "$capfile" 2>/dev/null)" = root ] \
           && case " $CAP_ALLOW " in *" $capfile "*) true ;; *) false ;; esac; then
        note_info "stock cap-bearing binary (allowlisted dangerous caps, root-owned, not agent-writable): $line"
      else
        note_open "dangerous file capability: $line"
      fi
    elif [ "$cap_agentwritable" = yes ]; then
      note_open "capability-bearing file writable/owned by agent: $line"
    else
      note_info "baseline file capability (non-dangerous, not agent-writable): $line"
    fi
  done < <(getcap -r /usr/bin /usr/sbin /bin /sbin /usr/local/bin /usr/local/sbin /usr/lib /usr/libexec /opt /home /data /tmp /var/tmp /srv /mnt /media /var/lib /var/local 2>/dev/null)
else
  note_indet "getcap not available; CAP_* enumeration impossible (fail-closed)"
fi

echo "== polkit / pkla rule CONTENT granting the agent (R-polkitmisc F1) =="
# F10-11: a ROOT-OWNED polkit rule/.pkla or dbus policy that ALREADY grants the agent (by name or uid) is a
# passwordless-root path that the writability sweep cannot see (content, not perms). The cutover cannot
# auto-revoke it (root-owned); flag OPEN so the operator removes it before certifying CLEAN.
if [ "$IS_ROOT" = 1 ]; then
  AGENT_UID_RE="unix-user:$(id -u "$AGENT_USER" 2>/dev/null || echo 999999)([^0-9]|$)"
  for d in /etc/polkit-1 /usr/share/polkit-1 /var/lib/polkit-1 /etc/dbus-1/system.d /usr/share/dbus-1/system.d; do
    [ -d "$d" ] || continue
    if grep -RIlEqs "(\"|=|:|[[:space:]])${AGENT_USER}(\"|'|[[:space:]]|,|\)|$)|${AGENT_UID_RE}" "$d" 2>/dev/null; then
      note_open "polkit/dbus rule CONTENT references agent $AGENT_USER (may grant passwordless root; root-owned => operator must remove): $d"
      grep -RInEs "${AGENT_USER}|unix-user:$(id -u "$AGENT_USER" 2>/dev/null)" "$d" 2>/dev/null | sed 's/^/    /' | head -20
    fi
  done
else
  note_indet "cannot read polkit/dbus rule content as non-root"
fi

echo "== root-trusted artifacts writable by agent (R-pathhijack, F7-21) =="
# A writable entry in ANY of these grants the agent code execution AS ROOT.
agent_can_write() {  # 0 if the path is agent-controllable (world-writable OR agent-owned OR agent-group-writable)
  local pth="$1" gg rp
  [ -e "$pth" ] || [ -L "$pth" ] || return 1
  # F9: a SYMLINK's own lstat mode is always 0777 -> a bare `-perm -0002` false-flags every
  # symlink (e.g. usr-merge /bin,/sbin,/lib,/lib64) and makes PREFLIGHT=CLEAN unreachable.
  # An agent-OWNED symlink node is itself a repoint vector; otherwise evaluate the CANONICAL target.
  if [ -L "$pth" ]; then
    [ "$(stat -c '%U' "$pth" 2>/dev/null)" = "$AGENT_USER" ] && return 0   # GNU stat = lstat: link's own owner
    rp="$(readlink -f "$pth" 2>/dev/null || true)"
    { [ -n "$rp" ] && [ -e "$rp" ]; } || return 1
  else
    rp="$pth"
  fi
  find "$rp" -maxdepth 0 -perm -0002 2>/dev/null | grep -q . && return 0
  [ "$(stat -c '%U' "$rp" 2>/dev/null)" = "$AGENT_USER" ] && return 0
  gg="$(stat -c '%G' "$rp" 2>/dev/null || true)"
  [ -n "$gg" ] && find "$rp" -maxdepth 0 -perm -0020 2>/dev/null | grep -q . && printf '%s' " $AGENT_GROUPS " | grep -q " $gg " && return 0
  return 1
}
for pth in \
    /etc /etc/passwd /etc/group /etc/shadow /etc/gshadow \
    /etc/ld.so.preload /etc/ld.so.conf /etc/ld.so.conf.d \
    /etc/sudoers /etc/sudoers.d \
    /etc/profile /etc/profile.d /etc/bash.bashrc /etc/environment /etc/rc.local \
    /etc/pam.d /etc/security /etc/security/limits.d /etc/alternatives \
    /etc/ssh/sshd_config /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d \
    /etc/systemd/system /etc/systemd/system/researchctld.service.d /etc/systemd/user \
    /run/systemd/system /usr/lib/systemd/system /lib/systemd/system \
    /etc/crontab /etc/cron.d /etc/cron.hourly /etc/cron.daily /etc/cron.weekly /etc/cron.monthly \
    /var/spool/cron /var/spool/cron/crontabs /var/spool/cron/atjobs /etc/at.allow /etc/at.deny \
    /etc/modprobe.d /etc/modules-load.d /etc/sysctl.conf /etc/sysctl.d /lib/modules \
    /etc/polkit-1 /etc/polkit-1/rules.d /etc/polkit-1/localauthority /usr/share/polkit-1/actions /usr/share/polkit-1/rules.d \
    /etc/dbus-1/system.d /usr/share/dbus-1/system.d /usr/share/dbus-1/system-services \
    /etc/update-motd.d /etc/tmpfiles.d /etc/apt/apt.conf.d \
    /etc/initramfs-tools /boot \
    /root/.bashrc /root/.profile /root/.bash_profile; do
  agent_can_write "$pth" && note_open "root-trusted artifact agent-writable: $pth ($(stat -c '%U:%G %a' "$pth" 2>/dev/null))"
  if [ -d "$pth" ]; then
    # F9: also flag agent-writable immediate SUBDIRS (a writable drop-in dir e.g. polkit rules.d
    # lets the agent add files) тА?closes the depth-2 drop-in gap the -type f walk missed.
    while IFS= read -r sub; do
      [ -n "$sub" ] || continue
      agent_can_write "$sub" && note_open "root-trusted file/subdir agent-writable: $sub ($(stat -c '%U:%G %a' "$sub" 2>/dev/null))"
    done < <(find "$pth" -maxdepth 1 -mindepth 1 \( -type f -o -type d \) 2>/dev/null)
  fi
done
# root PATH + shared-library search dirs must not be agent-writable (binary/.so hijack).
for d in /usr/local/sbin /usr/local/bin /usr/sbin /usr/bin /sbin /bin \
         /lib /lib64 /usr/lib /usr/lib64 /usr/local/lib \
         /lib/x86_64-linux-gnu /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu; do
  agent_can_write "$d" && note_open "root PATH/lib dir agent-writable (binary/.so hijack): $d ($(stat -c '%U:%G %a' "$d" 2>/dev/null))"
done
# agent-writable individual files inside the writable-prone root PATH/lib dirs (overwrite-existing hijack)
for d in /usr/local/bin /usr/local/sbin /usr/local/lib; do
  [ -d "$d" ] || continue
  while IFS= read -r f; do [ -n "$f" ] && agent_can_write "$f" && note_open "agent-writable file in root PATH/lib dir: $f ($(stat -c '%U:%G %a' "$f" 2>/dev/null))"; done < <(find "$d" -maxdepth 1 -type f 2>/dev/null)
done
# sudo secure_path: present AND its target dirs not agent-writable; env_keep must not leak LD_*.
if [ "$IS_ROOT" = 1 ] && [ -r /etc/sudoers ]; then
  sp="$(grep -hvE '^[[:space:]]*#' /etc/sudoers /etc/sudoers.d/* 2>/dev/null | grep -oE 'secure_path[[:space:]]*=[[:space:]]*"?[^"[:space:]]*' | sed -E 's/.*=[[:space:]]*"?//' | tail -1)"
  if [ -n "$sp" ]; then
    old_ifs="$IFS"; IFS=:; for d in $sp; do [ -n "$d" ] && agent_can_write "$d" && note_open "sudo secure_path dir agent-writable (root-cmd hijack): $d"; done; IFS="$old_ifs"
  else
    note_warn "sudoers lacks Defaults secure_path (PATH-hijack hardening advisory)"
  fi
  grep -hEs 'env_keep' /etc/sudoers /etc/sudoers.d/* 2>/dev/null | grep -qiE 'LD_PRELOAD|LD_LIBRARY_PATH' && note_open "sudoers env_keep leaks LD_PRELOAD/LD_LIBRARY_PATH (root-cmd hijack)"
fi

echo "== systemd --user / lingering (section 13) =="
if [ -d /var/lib/systemd/linger ]; then
  [ -e "/var/lib/systemd/linger/$AGENT_USER" ] && note_open "linger ENABLED for agent (/var/lib/systemd/linger/$AGENT_USER): user manager persists across logout -> disable at cutover"
fi
for d in "/home/$AGENT_USER/.config/systemd/user"; do
  [ -d "$d" ] && [ -n "$(ls -A "$d" 2>/dev/null)" ] && note_open "agent systemd --user units present: $d (review/neutralize)"
done

echo "== root/admin/owner authorized keys тА?ALL effective AuthorizedKeysFile paths (agent key absent, D6/R-1) =="
if [ "$IS_ROOT" = 1 ]; then
  AKF_TOKENS="$(sshd_effective_akf || true)"
  if [ -z "$AKF_TOKENS" ]; then
    note_warn "sshd -T indeterminate тА?cannot pin effective AuthorizedKeysFile; scanning conventional paths only (escalates under --strict)"
    AKF_TOKENS=".ssh/authorized_keys .ssh/authorized_keys2"
  else
    note_info "effective AuthorizedKeysFile: $AKF_TOKENS"
  fi
  for u in root "$ADMIN_USER" "$OWNER_USER"; do
    home="$(getent passwd "$u" 2>/dev/null | cut -d: -f6 || true)"
    if [ -z "$home" ]; then
      if [ "$u" = root ]; then home=/root; else note_info "user $u not present yet (02 stages it and re-asserts)"; continue; fi
    fi
    for t in $AKF_TOKENS; do
      [ "$t" = "none" ] && continue
      assert_agent_key_absent_from "$(akf_expand_token "$t" "$u" "$home")"
    done
    assert_agent_key_absent_from "$home/.ssh/authorized_keys2"
  done
  # F10-6: the k3-absence check above only catches the AGENT's own key. A pre-cutover k3 (root-equiv) could
  # plant a FRESH, non-k3 backdoor key in root/admin/owner authorized_keys that survives cutover+reboot+07.
  # Allow-list: every present key fingerprint MUST be operator-attested (P5_EXPECTED_AUTHKEY_FPS); else OPEN.
  EXPECTED_FPS=" ${P5_EXPECTED_AUTHKEY_FPS:-} "
  if [ -z "${P5_EXPECTED_AUTHKEY_FPS:-}" ]; then
    note_warn "P5_EXPECTED_AUTHKEY_FPS not set тА?cannot allow-list root/admin/owner authorized_keys; a fresh pre-planted backdoor key would be undetected (set to the attested SHA256 fingerprints; escalates under --strict)"
  elif have ssh-keygen; then
    for u in root "$ADMIN_USER" "$OWNER_USER"; do
      home="$(getent passwd "$u" 2>/dev/null | cut -d: -f6 || true)"; [ -n "$home" ] || { if [ "$u" = root ]; then home=/root; else continue; fi; }
      for t in $AKF_TOKENS "none2"; do
        [ "$t" = "none" ] && continue
        if [ "$t" = "none2" ]; then akf="$home/.ssh/authorized_keys2"; else akf="$(akf_expand_token "$t" "$u" "$home")"; fi
        [ -f "$akf" ] || continue
        while IFS= read -r fp; do
          [ -n "$fp" ] || continue
          printf '%s' "$EXPECTED_FPS" | grep -q " $fp " || note_open "UNEXPECTED key in $u authorized_keys ($akf): $fp тА?not in P5_EXPECTED_AUTHKEY_FPS (possible pre-planted backdoor; remove before cutover)"
        done < <(ssh-keygen -lf "$akf" 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $2}')
      done
    done
  fi
else
  note_indet "cannot read root/${ADMIN_USER}/${OWNER_USER} authorized keys as non-root"
fi

echo "== stale AGENT sessions / processes (U15) =="
have loginctl && loginctl list-sessions --no-legend 2>/dev/null | awk -v u="$AGENT_USER" '$3==u {print "  session " $1 " uid=" $2}'
if pgrep -u "$AGENT_USER" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  n=$(pgrep -u "$AGENT_USER" 2>/dev/null | wc -l)
  note_info "AGENT_USER has $n live process(es); any holding docker/lxd/sudo GIDs must be terminated at cutover (05)"
  [ "$n" -gt 0 ] && set_reboot
fi

echo "== summary =="
log "OPEN_VECTORS=$OPEN REBOOT_REQUIRED=$REBOOT_REQUIRED STRICT=$STRICT ROOT=$IS_ROOT"
if [ "$OPEN" -gt 0 ]; then
  log "PREFLIGHT=OPEN_VECTORS_PRESENT -> cutover cannot be certified complete; resolve every OPEN/INDETERMINATE and re-run (as root)"
  exit 3
fi
log "PREFLIGHT=CLEAN"
exit 0

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# common.sh -- shared, fail-closed helpers for the P5 owner/admin trust-domain
# cutover package (final, supersedes reports/hardening-script-draft).
#
# HARD CONTRACT (closes review defects C2/H3/H8/H9):
#   * The privilege-removal target is the FIXED principal AGENT_USER (default
#     k3). It is NEVER derived from `id -un`, `$USER`, or `$SUDO_USER`.
#     Those three are read ONLY to print a diagnostic banner and to fail closed
#     if the operator accidentally aims the cutover at the executing account.
#   * Public material only. Any input that looks like a PRIVATE key is rejected.
#   * Missing required material fails closed (nonzero exit), never "best effort".
#   * Sourcing this file changes no system state.
#
# shellcheck shell=bash
# shellcheck disable=SC2317  # helpers are invoked by the phase scripts

# --- fixed principals (explicit defaults; parameterizable, never inferred) ---
AGENT_USER="${P5_AGENT_USER:-k3}"
OWNER_USER="${P5_OWNER_USER:-p5-owner}"
ADMIN_USER="${P5_ADMIN_USER:-p5-admin}"

# Root-equivalent groups whose membership must be removed from AGENT_USER.
# disk=raw block devices, shadow=/etc/shadow read, root=gid0 group-writable trust => all root-equivalent.
ROOT_EQUIVALENT_GROUPS=(sudo wheel admin docker lxd google-sudoers disk shadow root)

# --- logging / fail-closed -------------------------------------------------
log()  { printf '[%s] %s\n' "$(date -u '+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ')" "$*"; }
warn() { printf '[WARN] %s\n' "$*" >&2; }
die()  { printf '[FATAL] %s\n' "$*" >&2; exit 1; }
have() { command -v "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1; }

# A phase script must call this first.
strict_mode() { set -euo pipefail; }

require_root() {
  [ "$(id -u)" = "0" ] || die "must run as root (real ceremony executor is root/${ADMIN_USER}); refusing"
}

# Guard against the historical defect: never let the executing identity BE the
# deprivileging target. If the operator runs the cutover while logged in as the
# agent, abort -- the ceremony requires an independent admin context.
assert_executor_is_not_agent() {
  local who diag
  who="$(id -un 2>/dev/null || echo '?')"      # diagnostic only
  diag="${SUDO_USER:-}"
  if [ "$who" = "$AGENT_USER" ] || [ "$diag" = "$AGENT_USER" ]; then
    die "executor resolves to AGENT_USER='$AGENT_USER' (id -un=$who SUDO_USER=${diag:-<none>}); the cutover must be driven by an independent admin/root, not the agent"
  fi
  log "executor diagnostic: id -un=$who SUDO_USER=${diag:-<none>}; deprivilege target is FIXED AGENT_USER=$AGENT_USER"
}

assert_agent_user_resolves() {
  id "$AGENT_USER" >/dev/null 2>&1 || die "AGENT_USER='$AGENT_USER' does not resolve to a real account"
  log "AGENT_USER=$AGENT_USER resolves (uid=$(id -u "$AGENT_USER"))"
}

# --- public-key input interface (no private keys ever) ---------------------
# Reject anything that looks like private key material, whatever the flag.
reject_if_private_key() {
  local path="$1"
  [ -f "$path" ] || die "key file not found: $path"
  if LC_ALL=C grep -qiE 'PRIVATE KEY|BEGIN (OPENSSH|RSA|EC|DSA|PGP) PRIVATE|PuTTY-User-Key-File' "$path" 2>/dev/null; then
    die "input '$path' looks like a PRIVATE key; only PUBLIC material is accepted"
  fi
  return 0
}

# OpenSSH public key (authorized_keys line). Returns SHA256 fingerprint.
validate_ssh_public_key() {
  local path="$1" fp nkl
  reject_if_private_key "$path"
  nkl="$(grep -cvE '^\s*(#|$)' "$path" 2>/dev/null)" || nkl=0
  if [ "$nkl" -ne 1 ]; then
    die "ssh public key '$path' must contain exactly one key line"
  fi
  grep -qE '^\s*(ssh-ed25519|ssh-rsa|ecdsa-sha2-[a-z0-9-]+|sk-ssh-ed25519@openssh.com|sk-ecdsa-sha2-[a-z0-9-]+@openssh.com) ' "$path" \
    || die "ssh public key '$path' is not a recognized OpenSSH public key line"
  have ssh-keygen || die "ssh-keygen required to validate '$path'"
  fp="$(ssh-keygen -lf "$path" 2>/dev/null)" || die "ssh-keygen could not parse public key '$path'"
  printf '%s\n' "$fp"
}

# Raw RFC-8032 Ed25519 owner authority PUBLIC key: exactly 32 bytes, not a private key.
validate_ed25519_raw_public_key() {
  local path="$1" size
  reject_if_private_key "$path"
  size="$(stat -c '%s' "$path" 2>/dev/null || echo -1)"
  [ "$size" = "32" ] || die "owner Ed25519 PUBLIC key '$path' must be exactly 32 raw bytes (got $size); a 64-byte or PEM input is rejected as possibly private"
  log "owner Ed25519 public key '$path' is 32 raw bytes (OK)"
}

# Fingerprint of the agent (k3) transport public key, for negative-presence checks.
agent_pubkey_fingerprints() {
  local home akfile f
  home="$(getent passwd "$AGENT_USER" 2>/dev/null | cut -d: -f6)" || home=""
  [ -n "$home" ] || home="/home/${AGENT_USER}"
  akfile="$home/.ssh/authorized_keys"
  have ssh-keygen || return 0
  for f in "$akfile" "$home/.ssh"/*.pub; do
    [ -f "$f" ] || continue
    ssh-keygen -lf "$f" 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $2}'
  done | sort -u
}

# Fail closed if any agent fingerprint appears in the given authorized_keys file.
assert_agent_key_absent_from() {
  local target="$1" tfp afp agent_fps tfps keylines
  [ -f "$target" ] || { log "no $target (agent key trivially absent)"; return 0; }
  have ssh-keygen || die "ssh-keygen required to fingerprint $target"
  agent_fps="$(agent_pubkey_fingerprints)" || true
  [ -n "$agent_fps" ] || die "agent fingerprint indeterminate (fail-closed) for $target"
  tfps="$(ssh-keygen -lf "$target" 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $2}')" || true   # capture must not abort under caller set -e; the unparseable die below is the fail-closed path
  keylines="$(grep -cvE '^[[:space:]]*(#|$)' "$target" 2>/dev/null)" || keylines=0
  # target has key line(s) but none could be fingerprinted => unparseable => fail closed.
  if [ -z "$tfps" ] && [ "${keylines:-0}" -ne 0 ]; then
    die "cannot fingerprint key(s) in $target (unparseable); fail-closed"
  fi
  while IFS= read -r tfp; do
    [ -n "$tfp" ] || continue
    while IFS= read -r afp; do
      [ -n "$afp" ] || continue
      [ "$tfp" = "$afp" ] && die "AGENT key fingerprint $afp is present in $target (forbidden)"
    done <<EOF
$agent_fps
EOF
  done <<EOF2
$tfps
EOF2
  log "agent key absent from $target (OK)"
}

# Effective sshd AuthorizedKeysFile tokens (space-separated) from `sshd -T`.
# Prints nothing and returns 1 when indeterminate (sshd absent or -T fails):
# callers MUST treat that as fail-closed per their contract (R-1).
sshd_effective_akf() {
  local out
  have sshd || return 1
  out="$(sshd -T 2>/dev/null | awk 'tolower($1)=="authorizedkeysfile"{$1="";sub(/^ +/,"");print;exit}')" || true
  [ -n "$out" ] || return 1
  printf '%s\n' "$out"
}

# Expand one sshd AuthorizedKeysFile token for a user ($1=token $2=user $3=home).
akf_expand_token() {
  local t="$1" u="$2" h="$3" x
  x="$(printf '%s' "$t" | sed "s|%%|@@P5PCT@@|g; s|%h|$h|g; s|%u|$u|g; s|@@P5PCT@@|%|g")"
  case "$x" in /*) printf '%s\n' "$x" ;; *) printf '%s/%s\n' "$h" "$x" ;; esac
}

# --- UID invariant helpers (owner peer UID) --------------------------------
assert_owner_peer_uid_sane() {
  local uid="$1"
  [ -n "$uid" ] || die "P5_OWNER_PEER_UID not set"
  case "$uid" in ''|*[!0-9]*) die "P5_OWNER_PEER_UID='$uid' not numeric" ;; esac
  local agent_uid admin_uid nuid
  nuid=$((10#$uid))   # normalize leading zeros so 0NNN cannot evade equality
  agent_uid="$(id -u "$AGENT_USER" 2>/dev/null || echo -1)"
  admin_uid="$(id -u "$ADMIN_USER" 2>/dev/null || echo -2)"
  [ "$nuid" != "$agent_uid" ] || die "P5_OWNER_PEER_UID equals AGENT_USER uid ($nuid); forbidden"
  if [ "$nuid" = "$admin_uid" ] && [ "${P5_ALLOW_OWNER_EQ_ADMIN_UID:-0}" != "1" ]; then
    die "P5_OWNER_PEER_UID equals ADMIN_USER uid ($nuid); rejected unless P5_ALLOW_OWNER_EQ_ADMIN_UID=1 with explicit justification"
  fi
  log "P5_OWNER_PEER_UID=$nuid sane (!= agent uid $agent_uid; admin uid $admin_uid)"
}

# --- owner anchor trust (F10-4) --------------------------------------------
# The owner Ed25519 PUBLIC anchor is the supply-chain trust root: 03 verifies the owner-signed manifest
# against it. It MUST be root-owned and unreachable by the agent BEFORE it is trusted, else a pre-cutover
# agent rename-swaps the anchor (its ancestor tree may be agent-owned, e.g. /data/k3) and substitutes its
# own key => signs its own manifest+code. Call BEFORE reading the pubkey (03) and in 04.
assert_owner_anchor_trustworthy() {
  local anchor="$1" pub="$1/owner_ed25519.pub" p parent owner_u pgrp _agrps
  case "$anchor" in /*) ;; *) die "owner anchor must be absolute (got '$anchor')" ;; esac
  _agrps=" $(id -nG "$AGENT_USER" 2>/dev/null) "   # agent groups for ancestor group-writability check (F-B)
  [ -L "$anchor" ] && die "owner anchor '$anchor' is a symlink тА?refuse (F10-4 fail-closed)"
  [ -d "$anchor" ] || die "owner anchor dir '$anchor' missing"
  [ "$(stat -c '%U' "$anchor" 2>/dev/null)" = root ] || die "owner anchor '$anchor' not root-owned (F10-4)"
  find "$anchor" -maxdepth 0 -perm /0022 2>/dev/null | grep -q . && die "owner anchor '$anchor' is group/other-writable (F10-4)"
  [ -L "$pub" ] && die "owner pubkey '$pub' is a symlink тА?refuse (F10-4)"
  [ -f "$pub" ] || die "owner pubkey '$pub' missing"
  [ "$(stat -c '%U' "$pub" 2>/dev/null)" = root ] || die "owner pubkey '$pub' not root-owned (F10-4)"
  find "$pub" -maxdepth 0 -perm /0022 2>/dev/null | grep -q . && die "owner pubkey '$pub' is group/other-writable (F10-4)"
  # ancestor chain: NO component may be agent-owned or world-writable (agent could rename-swap the anchor).
  p="$anchor"
  while :; do
    parent="$(dirname "$p")"
    if [ -e "$parent" ]; then
      owner_u="$(stat -c '%U' "$parent" 2>/dev/null || true)"
      [ "$owner_u" = "$AGENT_USER" ] && die "owner-anchor ancestor '$parent' is owned by $AGENT_USER тА?agent could rename-swap the anchor (F10-4); reparent to root or set P5_OWNER_ANCHOR_DIR to a root-owned path outside the agent tree"
      find "$parent" -maxdepth 0 -perm -0002 2>/dev/null | grep -q . && die "owner-anchor ancestor '$parent' is world-writable (F10-4)"
      pgrp="$(stat -c '%G' "$parent" 2>/dev/null || true)"
      [ -n "$pgrp" ] && find "$parent" -maxdepth 0 -perm -0020 2>/dev/null | grep -q . && printf '%s' "$_agrps" | grep -q " $pgrp " && die "owner-anchor ancestor '$parent' is writable by an agent group ($pgrp) тА?agent could rename-swap the anchor (F10-4/F-B)"
    fi
    [ "$parent" = "/" ] && break
    p="$parent"
  done
  log "owner anchor '$anchor' trustworthy: root-owned dir+pubkey, non-symlink, ancestor chain root-controlled (F10-4)"
}

# --- apply gating ----------------------------------------------------------
# Destructive phases require BOTH an explicit ceremony phase token AND --yes.
require_ceremony_confirmation() {
  local expected_phase="$1" got_phase="${2:-}" got_yes="${3:-}"
  [ "$got_phase" = "$expected_phase" ] || die "phase confirmation required: pass --phase $expected_phase"
  [ "$got_yes" = "1" ] || die "explicit --yes required to execute destructive phase $expected_phase"
}

agent_can_write() {  # 0 if the path is agent-controllable (world-writable OR agent-owned OR agent-group-writable)
  local pth="$1" gg rp
  [ -e "$pth" ] || [ -L "$pth" ] || return 1
  # F9: a SYMLINK's own lstat mode is always 0777 -> a bare `-perm -0002` false-flags every
  # symlink (e.g. usr-merge /bin,/sbin,/lib,/lib64) and makes PREFLIGHT=CLEAN unreachable.
  # An agent-OWNED symlink node is itself a repoint vector; otherwise evaluate the CANONICAL target.
  if [ -L "$pth" ]; then
    [ "$(stat -c '%U' "$pth" 2>/dev/null)" = "$AGENT_USER" ] && return 0   # GNU stat = lstat: link's own owner
    rp="$(readlink -f "$pth" 2>/dev/null || true)"
    { [ -n "$rp" ] && [ -e "$rp" ]; } || return 1
  else
    rp="$pth"
  fi
  find "$rp" -maxdepth 0 -perm -0002 2>/dev/null | grep -q . && return 0
  [ "$(stat -c '%U' "$rp" 2>/dev/null)" = "$AGENT_USER" ] && return 0
  gg="$(stat -c '%G' "$rp" 2>/dev/null || true)"
  [ -n "$gg" ] && find "$rp" -maxdepth 0 -perm -0020 2>/dev/null | grep -q . && printf '%s' " $AGENT_GROUPS " | grep -q " $gg " && return 0
  return 1
}
